identity.name: Perpetual Calendar
identity.one_liner: The 2017 perpetual calendar in white gold with cream-lume dial and syringe hands — the most-cited modern Patek perpetual calendar in the $50,000 price band.

narrative.story: The 5320G is the 2017 perpetual calendar that replaced the 5140. The cream-lume dial with blue accents and syringe hands is a deliberate reference to the 1940s Patek perpetual calendars. The 324 S Q caliber is the same as in the 5140. The 40mm case is the modern size. The 5320G is the most-cited modern Patek perpetual calendar because the dial layout reads as "Patek 1940s" without being a reissue, and the price is below the platinum 5370 and the perpetual chronograph 5270.
